methods.name: Sharp 7/26 raw X6 stability and all equality cases for three-positive coordinate stars
triggers: three positive coordinate star raw stability sharp 7/26 equality
X6 三正坐标星形 raw 稳定性 7/26 七角等幅取等
methods.input_contract: Two finite positive rational populations in one common external anchor and labelled raw signed X6 frame. Aggregate identical Cells and Jordan-cancel first. The three positive sites are exactly q_i=c+d_i*e_(a_i) with distinct a_i and nonzero integer d_i, and each positive mass is strictly positive. Negative support is arbitrary and finite in the original chart. Set P and N to Jordan totals, M=P+N, and D to the sum of all twenty complete raw three-axis marginal L1 norms; no equal-mass assumption.
methods.output_contract: 21*D>=78*M, equivalently M<=(7/26)*D, with sharp constant 7/26 in this star subclass. Every nonzero equality case has equal absolute mass at all seven corners: the three single-axis corners positive, and the base plus three pair corners negative. No triple corner or original-coordinate outsider occurs. Hence P:N=3:4 at equality; arbitrary common population may have cancelled first.
methods.core_law: The root-provided raw-table integer dual has |b|<=21, F=78 on each positive site and F<=-78 on every other original spatial point. The full nonnegative L1/negative-site gap proves the bound; strict common-axis losses and the nonsaturated coefficients 9 and -13 force equal absolute weights at exactly seven corners.
methods.hard_boundary: This is a coordinate-star upper bound, not an upper bound for arbitrary three-positive geometry. The original general-p3 7/26 lower-bound example remains owned by result.x6.three_positive_raw_mass_boundary and is not a second registration here. Sharp 7/26 equality has unequal totals 3:4 and is not an equal-mass witness. Raw addresses or lossless joint can3/common-offset are required; no branch count/history, paths, common-depth or microscopic BRC recovery follows. Signed analysis is not a negative BRC primitive. Paper evidence, indexing, executable validation and formal authority are distinct.

methods.name: Exact equal-mass raw X6 minimum for fixed three-positive star weights and the balanced equality simplex
triggers: three positive coordinate star fixed weight equal mass minimum D simplex
X6 三正坐标星形 固定正权 等质量 精确最小 D 单纯形
methods.input_contract: The same original labelled raw X6 coordinate-star shape after aggregation and Jordan cancellation, with fixed strictly positive rational masses w_1,w_2,w_3. Let P=sum(w_i), m=max(w_i), and require N=P for the arbitrary finite original negative support; then M=2P. D is the stacked sum of all twenty complete raw three-axis L1 norms.
methods.output_contract: The attained exact minimum is min D=max(8*P,24*m-4*P). The complete D=8*P equality family exists iff m<=P/2: set T=P-2*m, choose rational x_i>=0 with X=sum(x_i)<=T, and set negative base a=(P-X)/2 and pair v_ij=(w_i+w_j-w_k+X-2*x_k)/2. This is a bijection, permits zero pair weights, and is a singleton at T=0. When m>P/2, a=m, v_12=w_2, v_13=w_3, v_23=0 after selecting w_1=m attains the higher minimum; all higher-minimum distributions are not classified.
methods.core_law: The structural paper supplies D>=8*P under N=P. A second raw-table dual has F(q_1)=20, F(q_2)=F(q_3)=-4 and F<=0 elsewhere, giving D>=24*m-4*P. Explicit finite negative populations attain each branch. The old full L1 gap restricts D=8*P equality to base/pair support; its exact sign inequalities are equivalent to the stated simplex.
methods.hard_boundary: This is a fixed-star fixed-positive-weight equal-mass profile, not a global all-p3 theorem or an arbitrary-mass optimization. Only D=8*P minimizers are completely classified; m>P/2 has an attainer but no exhaustive minimizer classification here. The original symmetric a,b,c probe is a boundary consistency check, already registered by result.x6.three_positive_raw_mass_boundary, not a fourth source paper or duplicated result. Existing p<=1 or compression consumers are not executed or relabelled as weight-profile checkers. Signed analysis is not a negative BRC primitive; no formal authority or executable API is granted.
